invariants.rationale: The method always returns an object of type HoodieWriteMetadata, so result should not be null.
The list of prepped records to insert should not be null at method exit for normal usage.
instantTime is a key operation parameter and should not be null at method exit.
The HoodieEngineContext should be present for processing.
The getWriteStatuses() should return a non-null List since the method is expected to process records and produce write statuses.
